Medtronic, ein Vorreiter in der Medizintechnik, sucht nach einem/r engagierten Technical Consultant für unser Team der Sakralen Neuromodulation (Pelvic Health) für die
deutschsprachigen Schweiz.

• Studium im betriebswirtschaftlichen-, oder im medizinischen/medizintechnischen Bereich

• Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift, Italienischkenntnisse wären von Vorteil l

Medtronic, pioniere della tecnologia medica, sta cercando un consulente tecnico dedicato per il nostro team di neuromodulazione sacra (Pelvic Health).

• Sei lo specialista del prodotto della neurostimolazione sacra o della stimolazione nervosa sacra e si basa sulla tua conoscenza.

Conoscenza ed esperienza necessarie:

• Studi in amministrazione aziendale, o ingegneria medica

• 2-5 anni di esperienza in posizioni comparabili, preferibilmente in tecnologia medica, con un successo dimostrabile nell'assistenza clienti e nella fedeltà

• tedesco e inglese fluente in parole e scrittura, la conoscenza dell'italiano sarebbe un vantaggio

Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
Welcome to Medtronic, we improve the quality of life of our patients

Medtronic, a pioneer in medical technology, is looking for a dedicated technical consultant for our team of sacred neuromodulation (Pelvic Health).
German-speaking Switzerland.

The role of the Technical Consultant (TC) is to support our customers with applications related to the Sacred Neuromodulation (SNM) product area, especially implantation and aftercare. This is done in close coordination with the area responsible, the Therapy Sales Specialists. They build close relationships with customers, provide on-site technical support, act as a link between customers and internal teams in order to be able to offer our service and product solutions to customers in a timely and successful manner.

Become part of a team that changes patients’ lives: Support professionals inside and outside the operating room and bring innovation to the healthcare industry. Build trusting partnerships with healthcare professionals and advance groundbreaking technologies. Make the difference – apply now!

This position covers the regions – Central Switzerland (Luzern, Zurich) and is therefore a remote position. Remote means that your home address is considered the primary place of work (home office). Meetings may occasionally require your presence in the Medtronic Office.
Responsibilities include as follows:

• Technical surgical support for doctors and surgical staff, mainly urologists/gynecologists as well as surgeons and proctologists in hospitals, clinics and outpatient facilities.

• Support of our customers through surgical aftercare in the form of product instructions and programming, patient training as well as assistance with inquiries from doctors, nurses and patients.

• Implementation of training courses, workshops and product training for customers, participation in doctor training and accompanying doctors.

• Market monitoring, exchange and dissemination of current market information

• Participation in national and international congresses and events

• Ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction through close support and excellent service

• You are the product specialist of sacred neurostimulation or Sacred nerve stimulation and one relies on your knowledge.

Required knowledge and experience:

• Studies in business administration, or medical/medical engineering

• 2-5 years of experience in comparable positions, preferably in medical technology, with a demonstrable success in customer support and loyalty

• German and English fluent in words and writing, knowledge of Italian would be an advantage

• Secure appearance, strong communication strengths and team spirit

• Good MS Office and IT skills

• Very good presentation skills

• High operational readiness, flexibility and resilience, combined with high travel activity in Switzerland

• Independent working methods as well as efficient time and task planning are among your strengths

Medtronic, pionnier de la technologie médicale, est à la recherche d'un consultant technique dédié pour notre équipe de neuromodulation sacrée (Pelvic Health).
Suisse germanophone.

Le rôle du Technical Consultant (TC) est de soutenir nos clients avec des applications liées à la zone de produit de la Neuromodulation Sacrée (SNM), en particulier l'implantation et le suivi. Ceci est fait en étroite coordination avec la zone responsable, les spécialistes de la vente de thérapie. Devenez membre d'une équipe qui change la vie des patients : soutenez les professionnels à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la salle d'opération et apportez de l'innovation dans l'industrie de la santé. Établir des partenariats de confiance avec les professionnels de la santé et faire progresser les technologies novatrices. Faites la différence – appliquez maintenant!

Cette position couvre les régions – Suisse centrale (Luzern, Zurich) et est donc une position éloignée. Remote signifie que votre adresse à domicile est considérée comme le lieu de travail principal (bureau à domicile). Les réunions peuvent parfois nécessiter votre présence au Bureau Medtronic.
Les responsabilités sont les suivantes :

• Soutien technique chirurgical aux médecins et au personnel chirurgical, principalement aux urologues et aux gynécologues, ainsi qu'aux chirurgiens et aux proctologues dans les hôpitaux, les cliniques et les services ambulatoires.

• Soutien de nos clients par le biais de soins postopératoires chirurgicaux sous forme d'instructions et de programmes, de formation des patients ainsi que d'aide aux demandes de médecins, d'infirmières et de patients.

• Mise en place de cours de formation, d'ateliers et de formation de produits à l'intention des clients, participation à la formation des médecins et accompagnement des médecins.

• Surveillance, échange et diffusion des informations actuelles sur le marché

• Participation aux congrès et manifestations nationaux et internationaux

• Assurer un haut niveau de satisfaction de la clientèle grâce à un soutien étroit et à un excellent service

• Vous êtes le spécialiste du produit de la neurostimulation sacrée ou de la stimulation nerveuse sacrée.

Connaissances et expérience requises:

• Études en administration des affaires ou en génie médical/médical

• 2-5 ans d'expérience dans des postes comparables, de préférence dans la technologie médicale, avec un succès démontrable dans le soutien à la clientèle et la fidélité

• Allemand et anglais parlant couramment les mots et l'écriture, la connaissance de l'italien serait un avantage

• Aspect sûr, fortes forces de communication et esprit d'équipe

• Bonnes compétences en MS Office et en TI

• Très bonne présentation

• Haute disponibilité opérationnelle, flexibilité et résilience, associées à une forte activité de voyage en Suisse

The role supports the Environmental, Health, and Safety projects at the Medtronic Tolochenaz facilities. The EHS Engineer works under the direction and supervision of the EHS Leader.

As an individual contributor, you will also function in a team environment to ensure EHS compliance and identify, prevent, and resolve potential EHS issues and to mitigate EHS liabilities associated with current operations. A Day in the Life

• Develops, follow, and implements environmental, health, and safety project in accordance with governmental requirements and Medtronic Enterprise policies

• Provides technical support, which may include program/system training, program/system documentation, data extraction, data review, and tracking

• Monitors site indicators and ensure appropriate reporting.

• Monitor prevention activities, compliance, and auditing effort.

• Conducts studies and prepares environmental impact reports for new construction projects, plant processes and permit changes.

• Monitors projects and recommends changes to improve EHS efficiency.

• Maintain all required records and documentation. Review and analyse environmental documentation issued by regulatory agencies; collaborate with regulatory agencies to determine corrective action plans.

• Assist EHS team in data analysis to identify trends. Develop corrective and preventative actions.

• Facilitate site specific Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Training requirements.

• Evaluate proposed regulations to determine financial, industrial, public and environmental impact.

• Interact with regulatory bodies to resolve compliance issues; establish permit requirements and assist in regulatory audits.

• Examen professionnel fédéral de « Spécialiste de la sécurité au travail et de la protection de la santé (STPS) or equivalent.

• Bachelor of Science or equivalent Degree in Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Engineering, Health and Safety or related technical discipline.

• 3-5 years’ experience in EHS activities supporting a manufacturing site with a focus on environmental programs, permitting and reporting.

• Regulatory knowledge working under Swiss confederation and/or equivalent regulations such as ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 or capable of learning requirements

• Established and productive individual contributor.

• Works independently with general supervision on larger, complex projects / assignments.

• Fluent written and spoken in English and French.

The Equipment Development Engineering function develops manufacturing equipment, automation, and software solutions that enable safe, reliable, and scalable production. This leader plays a critical role in bridging R&D and Operations, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions from early concepts to high volume production. Key 
• Responsibilities
Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team across multiple technical disciplines, define organizational priorities aligned with site and global strategies, while also driving employee engagement, capability development, succession planning, and talent growth.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, and execute the Equipment Development Engineering roadmap supporting equipment development, manufacturing automation and software engineering
Partner with R&D, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Global Engineering functions to accelerate product launches and manufacturing readiness.
Lead development and deployment of advanced manufacturing equipment and automation solutions, support the site's automation roadmap, including labor efficiency, quality improvement, and programmatic savings initiatives, while also ensuring robust equipment design, qualification, validation, and transfer to manufacturing.
Drive development of manufacturing processes for new products and technology platforms, provide technical leadership for industrialization strategies and manufacturing transfers, support execution of strategic programs and new product introduction projects.
Drive performance through quality, delivery, cost and innovation metrics, while also establishing strong governance and execution rigor for engineering projects.
Champion continuous improvement and best practice standardization.

Required 
• Qualifications
Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Biomedical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or related field).
Minimum 10 years of engineering experience in medical devices or high volumes industries (Microelectronic, Automative, Pharma).
Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience.
Proven experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Experience in product industrialization, process development, manufacturing engineering, or automation.
Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.
